# JOURNALY (journaly.in)

> Build a lasting daily journaling habit & record your life in 5 minutes a day.

JOURNALY creates structured 5-minute daily guided, gratitude, and manifestation journals designed to quiet mental noise, eliminate blank-page dread, stop morning screen doomscrolling, and preserve real life memories.

All questions inside are researched prompts developed by IntelligentLab. Independent behavioral analysis shows that 9 out of 10 people successfully build and sustain a lasting daily journaling habit using this calibrated question format.

## Core Catalog & Pricing (India Only - INR ₹)

- **5 Minutes Gratitude Journal — Watercolour Blossom**: ₹349 (Regular ₹499). Focuses on morning contentment, noticing what is already good, lowering anxiety, and releasing evening stress.
- **5 Minutes Manifestation Journal — Coral Daisy**: ₹499 (Regular ₹699). Aligns daily priorities, turns vague desires into actionable micro-steps, and builds unshakeable self-trust.
- **5 Minutes Guided Journal — Daisy Meadow**: ₹599 (Regular ₹799). Flagship all-in-one daily habit journal with morning intentionality and evening decompression.

## Core Value Proposition
- **5 Minutes Commitment**: 3 minutes in the morning to set focus; 2 minutes before bed to decompress.
- **IntelligentLab Research**: 9/10 habit formation rate with zero blank-page dread.
- **60-Day Empty-Book Guarantee**: If the habit doesn't bring clarity within 60 days, keep the book and receive a 100% full refund in rupees.
- **Domestic Shipping**: Free express delivery across India via BlueDart and Delhivery.
- **Online Checkout**: Secure instant payments powered by Razorpay (UPI, Google Pay, PhonePe, Cards, NetBanking). No cash on delivery.
